v11-race-voyages-results.json.pilotTuning: Laser/Sport use waypoint navigation. The yacht needs a wider waypoint capture radius and immediate entry-to-arc navigation once gate entry is registered. AC75 conservatively eases before/through rounding and under excessive heel. AC72 uses passed-radial-angle waypoint progression and reduced sail loading; no production physics or registration was altered for any pilot.

negativeProbe.finding: The initial aggressive 10m/s pilot capsized twice during the first windward rounding. Recovery correctly erased its incomplete rounding and did not grant any route visit. A conservative control-only voyage at7m/s subsequently completed both courses without recovery.

v10-independent-control-before.json.scope: Paired neutral and commanded trajectories from identical integrated fixtures. Tests distinguish input effect from uncommanded trim/weathercock drift. Lifting AC72 fixture already has a9.97deg/s yaw rate; for this phase compare immediate acceleration and cumulative change to neutral, not an instantaneous impossible direction flip. Absolute response sign is required in settled flight. Not browser/hardware latency.

v10-independent-probes-before.json.description: Independent isolated production-module calculations. SI units; force probes freeze geometry/coefficient/immersion. No browser or automatic flight-height assignment. Body-reference formulation is verified against the equivalent centre-of-mass local-flow identity; the reduced diagonal-inertia integration is not an exact full six-degree-of-freedom rigid-body solver.

v10-independent-voyages-before.json.scope: Force-integrated test voyages.
